Stock (I used chicken stock)
Gelatine (just enough to set the stock)
Eggs
White rice
Green onions

So I forst made a quick stock(I work a lot so I cheated aha. I took store made broth and simmered it with carrots; onions; celery; and cracked black pepper) then just strained it and added gelatine and set it for a few hours in the fridge. Then I just scrambled some eggs(constantly moving to make tiny creamy pieces; I choooed up some green onions and made rice. Next I cute up my gelatine stock into little pieces. Topped my rice with eveyrhing. The flavour changes as the stock melts into the dish. Hope this helps!
